body: Cardi B and her grandmother rapping along to Cardi’s iconic breakout hit “Bodak Yellow” in 2017 Cardi B’s grandma pulling up and vibing to “Bodak Yellow” in the song’s early days is too funny. Cardi really had her grandma showing love to the track before it became the massive hit it is today. The way her grandma was getting into the song makes the moment even better. She wasn’t just standing around watching Cardi, she was actually feeling the music.

source_caption_text:
Cardi B and her grandmother rapping along to Cardi’s iconic breakout hit “Bodak Yellow” in 2017 😤🔥

Cardi B’s grandma pulling up and vibing to “Bodak Yellow” in the song’s early days is too funny. Cardi really had her grandma showing love to the track before it became the massive hit it is today.

The way her grandma was getting into the song makes the moment even better. She wasn’t just standing around watching Cardi, she was actually feeling the music.

“My gmom really a G thooo” is the perfect way to describe it. Cardi’s grandma was really showing out for her, and you can tell the love was real.

#cardib #bodakyellow #hiphop
